For claims that qualify, the Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment will be calculated as: Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment = [Claim Cost – Outlier Threshold] * DRG Marginal Cost Percentage. The DRG Marginal Cost Percentage is 90% for burn DRGs and 80% for all other DRGs. Additionally, qualifying administrative days are paid at per diems when billed separately from acute services.
